narrative.text: Vyktor and Theron enter your office looking grim. The police raided an illegal high-stakes gambling den last night. Among the arrested is Senator Gregor Vane—a conservative Halvekist who controls 10 crucial votes needed to pass your upcoming budget bill.
Vane is begging us to bury the police report. If this goes public, he resigns in disgrace, and we lose his 10 votes. The budget fails. The government shuts down.

Burying a police report is obstruction of justice, Chancellor. But if we expose him, we hand Kolvar a victory. The reformists want him gone, but the state needs his votes. It is a legal and political nightmare.

A corrupt senator caught with his hand in the cookie jar. He is exactly the kind of old-guard politician I swore to clean out. But he is also the only thing standing between me and a budget crisis. Do I enforce the law and sink my own government, or do I become the thing I hate and protect him?

choices.text: Bury the report. Blackmail Vane for his votes.
Expose him. Demand his resignation. The law is the law.
Force him to publicly resign and endorse you as a 'changed man' to secure his votes for his successor.
